constraints: form must belong to aTable (or the default table, if aTable is omitted); this command is not compatible with project forms.
Does not display the form; it only designates which form is printed, displayed as a list, or exported in the current process, until changed or the process ends.
If the specified form does not exist, the table's default output form (defined in the Explorer) is used instead.
Used by three groups of commands: list display (DISPLAY SELECTION, MODIFY SELECTION), reporting (PRINT LABEL, PRINT SELECTION), and export (EXPORT DIF, EXPORT SYLK, EXPORT TEXT).
userForm lets a user form (built via _o_CREATE USER FORM) be designated instead of the plain output form, so several custom user forms can coexist and be switched between.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Designates, for the current process, which form (or user form) is used as the output form of aTable for list display, reporting, and export commands.
